book.animalflee.animal_husbandry_guide.l:
$(bold)Welcome to the Animal Husbandry Guide!$()

This book will teach you how to run a ranch: tame wild animals, learn their genders and diets, feed your livestock, let them breed, and master fishing and fish farming.

$(bold)Before you start:$()
Animals will flee from you! Hold food and right-click an animal to feed and tame it.
